warnings.message: Dependency 'scheduleOptimizer' failed. Calculations are based on estimated location days from coordinator input, not an optimized schedule. This reduces the confidence of the estimate.

processingSteps.summary: Calculated fees for 3 practical African locations and rental costs for a major UK-based studio complex to house 10 large-scale set builds.
Calculated costs for international filming permits in Africa, including animal welfare and national park access. Added budget for engineering safety certifications for novel studio constructions.
Factored in costs for on-site security for remote African locations and high-level intellectual property protection at the studio.
Allocated funds for environmental restoration and damage bonds for practical locations, and a significant budget for the strike and disposal of massive studio sets.
Costed base camp infrastructure for the African shoot and extensive facilities, parking, and high-consumption power distribution for the studio portion.

processingEvidence.historicalContext: All costs are estimated in 1966 USD, reflecting the production era. Budgeting accounts for the pioneering nature of the production, including R&D for new techniques and higher contingencies for unprecedented technical challenges.

locationFees.description: Fees for access to national parks and private land for all 'Dawn of Man' sequences.

permitsAndLiaison.description: Government filming permits, animal welfare clearances, environmental assessments, and local fixer/liaison services.

security.description: Perimeter security for remote base camp and on-set wildlife/crowd control.

restorationAndCleanup.description: Damage/environmental bond and post-filming site restoration crew.

basecampFacilities.description: Setup of basecamp including tents, generators, water, waste management, and parking areas.

stageRental.description: Rental of 4 large soundstages, workshops, and office space for the duration of prep, shoot, and wrap.

utilitiesAndPower.description: Standard utilities plus high-consumption power for set mechanics (centrifuge) and large-scale lighting.

facilitiesAndParking.description: Parking fees for large crew and rental of temporary on-lot facilities (trailers, etc.).

sets.description: Pioneering 38-foot diameter, 30-ton rotating centrifuge set, plus associated corridors, pod bay, and cockpit. Includes engineering, fabrication, and mechanical operation.
Construction of high-finish, large-scale sets for the space station lounge/reception and multiple spacecraft interiors (cockpits, passenger areas).
Creation of a vast, realistic lunar surface, excavation pit, monolith housing, and moon base conference rooms/airlocks.
Specialized construction for the ornate hotel room set and rigs for the practical Stargate (slit-scan) effects.
Studio-based construction of cave interiors and other minor sets.

items.name: Set Strike and Restoration
items.description: Labor and disposal costs for dismantling and removing all custom sets and restoring soundstages to original condition.

items.name: Specialized Personnel
items.description: Fees for animal wranglers and on-site veterinarians for the African shoot.

items.name: Medical and Safety
items.description: On-set medics for both African and studio units, plus a dedicated safety supervisor for high-risk set operations (centrifuge, stunts).

items.name: International Logistics Support
items.description: Customs brokerage, carnet processing for equipment shipping to Africa.

items.name: High-Security Protocols
items.description: Enhanced security measures for protecting groundbreaking VFX techniques and set designs at the studio.

alternativeLocationOptions.option: Construct African landscapes in-studio or on a backlot
alternativeLocationOptions.pros: Greater control, no international travel logistics, reduced risk from wildlife.
alternativeLocationOptions.cons: Extremely high cost to replicate vast plains, potential lack of authenticity, would require significant VFX augmentation.

alternativeLocationOptions.pros: Potential access to a larger pool of specialized technicians.
alternativeLocationOptions.cons: Higher labor costs (union rates), potentially less favorable currency exchange at the time.

contingency.justification: High contingency due to the unprecedented and experimental nature of the set construction, mechanical effects, and the failure of the schedule optimizer dependency, introducing significant uncertainty.
